notes: Posted 11 May 2001, before Tatooine; the list has no Tatooine-set card, so the format is Premiere - Reflections II.

No starting section is posted; the strategy says 'Start Prep Def for TINT&OE and Mob Points. All Wrapped Up is my default starter.' Starting cards taken as Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die and Prepared Defenses (Prepared Defenses pulls There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement, Mobilization Points and All Wrapped Up); all are in the posted list and count toward the 60. Three Effects start and none is named as the starting Effect, so starting.effect is left empty.

Posted 'JP Audience Chamber', 'JP Dungeon', 'Tat Pit of Carkoon', 'Tat DB 94' and 'DS2 DB' dested Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber (Dark), Jabba's Palace: Dungeon, Tatooine: Great Pit Of Carkoon, the Dark Tatooine: Docking Bay 94 and Death Star II: Docking Bay.

Posted 'Mara Jade, The' dested Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'Dr E & Bonda B' Dr. Evazan & Ponda Baba; 'Boba with Gun', 'Iggy with Gun' and '4-LOM with Gun' the Enhanced characters Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle, IG-88 With Riot Gun and 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle.
Posted 'ZiMH', 'BiHT' and 'DiPO' dested Zuckuss In Mist Hunter, Bossk In Hound's Tooth and Dengar In Punishing One; 'Jabba's Cruiser' Jabba's Space Cruiser.
Posted 'Mara's stick' dested Mara Jade's Lightsaber; 'Stun Blaster' and 'Vibro-Ax' the Dark Stun Blaster and Vibro-Ax pages.

Posted 'TINT & OE' dested There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement; 'SaD' Search And Destroy; 'TBHTP' There'll Be Hell To Pay; 'Mob Points' Mobilization Points; 'YCHF' You Cannot Hide Forever; Secret Plans is an Effect in 2001.
Posted 'Prep Def' dested Prepared Defenses; 'Twi'Lek Adv' Twi'lek Advisor; 'Omni Box & It's Worse' Ommni Box & It's Worse.
The strategy mentions playing 'Battle Plan' with Rendili; the list has Battle Order, kept as posted.
